measurementOrigin: Local macOS client calling official MiniMax API directly. Network egress and provider region unverified. Not the hkg1 standard-report runner or browser timing.
design: 15 existing text tasks, 5 new edge-case tasks and 3 coding tasks, one attempt per mode. Sequential pairs with alternating mode order. No retries; all failures retained. Cache, route and load uncontrolled. Historical Space Bunny and Preview results are context only; no matched old-checkpoint baseline.

zh-CN.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash 实测：Space Bunny 身份、价格与 46 次测试结果
zh-CN.summary: Space Bunny 是 MiniMax M3.1 Flash 的早期版本。正式版 46 次实测：默认档文本 20/20，low 档 19/20；公开延迟、代码检查、金额错误与历史预览记录。

sections.title: 实测结论：默认档 20/20，low 档 19/20
sections.body:
MiniMax M3.1 Flash 的正式模型 ID 是 `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash`。TOKRACE 在 2026 年 10 月 20 日直接调用 MiniMax 官方 API，完成 **40 次文本任务请求与 6 次代码任务请求**。默认思考档（文档规定为 max）文本通过 20/20，low 档通过 19/20；两档各自通过全部 3 个代码任务。

20 道文本题的正文首响中位数分别为 **1.405 秒和 1.089 秒**。这是本次单轮、小样本、本地网络下的观测。涉及金额的任务建议保留默认档，并用程序复核计算结果；low 档的较短等待伴随一次真实计算失败。

sections.title: Space Bunny 是谁？从匿名预览到 MiniMax M3.1 Flash
sections.body:
[MiniMax 官方发布文](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-m31f)在 10 月 19 日确认，Space Bunny 是 M3.1 Flash 的**早期版本**。因此可以关联这两个名字，但不能把匿名阶段的成绩当作正式版成绩，或认定它们是同一个权重快照。

| 时间 | 身份与已有证据 |
| --- | --- |
| 9 月 27 日 | TOKRACE 使用 OpenRouter 的 `stealth/space-bunny-alpha` 完成 15 次文本测试，使用 low effort |
| 10 月 3 日 | 官方 `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview`：15 次文本测试与 3 次代码测试 |
| 10 月 19 日 | MiniMax 发布 M3.1 Flash，并披露 Space Bunny 的关系 |
| 10 月 20 日 | 本页对正式 ID 新测 46 次；旧 Space Bunny ID 连通性探测返回 HTTP 404 |

[阅读 Space Bunny 原始报告](/zh-CN/reports/launch-4a7f23b8cde24507-b682c375567c559a-r2) · [阅读 MiniMax Preview 原评测](/zh-CN/guides/minimax-m3-1-flash-preview)。历史证据保持原样。旧匿名接口本次返回 `No endpoints found for stealth/space-bunny-alpha.`，本站已退出该旧试用项；这不是模型能力不合格。Preview ID 同日探测仍返回 200，不能把“Preview 可用”理解为它与正式版相同。

sections.title: 基本信息、上下文与价格
sections.body:
| 项目 | 官方信息（10 月 20 日核验） |
| --- | --- |
| 开发者 / 正式名称 | MiniMax / MiniMax-M3.1-Flash |
| 发布时间 | 2026 年 10 月 19 日 |
| 上下文 | 1,000,000 tokens |
| 输入 | 文本、图片、视频；本页仅实测文本与代码 |
| 思考模式 | 必须启用；low、medium、high、xhigh、max；省略 effort 默认 max |
| 官方 API 定价 | 每百万 tokens：输入 $0.15，缓存读取 $0.015，输出 $0.60 |
| 权重 | 发布文称后续提供；本页未验证可下载权重 |

来源：[官方发布](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-m31f)、[模型指南](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/text-generation)。官方报告 DeepSWE v1.1 为 73.7%、OSWorld V2 为 61.7%；这些是**厂商公布的基准数据**，本页没有复现这些基准，也没有实测视觉、桌面操作或百万 token 长上下文。

sections.title: 测试方法与可复核范围
sections.body:
我们先固定 15 道站内基础题、5 道新增边界题，以及 3 道 JavaScript 编程题。每题在默认档和 low 档各请求一次，逐题交替两档先后顺序；**没有失败重试或挑选最佳答案**。基础题覆盖结构化抽取、指令遵循和有依据问答，新增题覆盖运费优惠、资料中伪指令、事件最终状态、作废信息与空值类型。

请求为 OpenAI 兼容接口 `https://api.minimax.io/v1/chat/completions`，`temperature=0`、流式输出、`reasoning_split=true`；文本 `max_tokens=2048`，代码 `8192`，单请求超时 120 秒。默认档不传 `reasoning_effort`；low 档显式传 `low`。文本按预定 JSON/答案检查，代码在隔离 VM 中执行预写断言。每档代码共 26 项检查，全部完成；得分单位仍为任务数。

正文首响从请求开始到第一个非空正文片段；思考首响另行记录，不能混用。输出 token 使用 API 的 completion_tokens，包含思考 token。调用从本地 macOS 发起，实际出口与服务区域未核实；缓存、负载与路由未控制。每题每档仅一次，不能证明稳定性、整体排名或全面推理能力。

sections.title: 文本与代码实测结果
sections.body:
| 指标 | 默认 max | low |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 原有基础题 | 15/15 | 15/15 |
| 新增边界题 | 5/5 | 4/5 |
| 文本合计 | 20/20 | 19/20 |
| 文本正文首响中位数 | 1.405 s | 1.089 s |
| 文本总耗时中位数 | 1.510 s | 1.158 s |
| 文本输出 token 合计（含思考） | 949 | 574 |
| 代码任务通过 | 3/3 | 3/3 |

| 代码任务 | 默认正文首响 | low 正文首响 | 结果 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 金额字符串转整数分（18 检查） | 25.020 s | 11.067 s | 两档通过 |
| 保持顺序去重（3 检查） | 1.568 s | 1.579 s | 两档通过 |
| 合并区间（5 检查） | 12.293 s | 2.084 s | 两档通过 |

这些代码是小函数测试，不代表仓库级修复、工具调用或真实 Agent 项目的成功率。

sections.title: 保留失败：low 档少算了 4.50 元运费
sections.body:
题目给出商品单价 19.90 元 × 3，运费 4.50 元，整单优惠 5.00 元。正确金额是 **59.20 元**，应返回 `{"totalCents":5920}`。low 档原样返回 `{"totalCents":5470}`，比正确值少 450 分，数值等于只计算商品金额减优惠。默认档返回 5920。

这是一项正确性失败，尽管 low 档的 JSON 格式合法。我们没有观察或公开内部思考过程，因此“漏运费”描述的是输出与正确式子的差异，不是对内部推理的诊断。[查看原始题目与回答](#evidence-edge-money-total-low)。

sections.title: 官方价格、免费路由与本次费用边界
sections.body:
按公开单价、API 报告的缓存命中与 token 用量，46 次正式测试的**标价等值估算约 $0.004424**。使用的是订阅凭证，这不是账单、实际扣费或新增现金支出，也不包括连通性探测和网页复测。

10 月 20 日查询 [OpenRouter 正式版条目](https://openrouter.ai/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free)还存在 `minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free`。这是另一条路由，免费窗口与可用性可能变化，本页没有通过它做 46 次评测。本站正式版试用调用 MiniMax 官方 API，并受本站额度限制；旧 `stealth/space-bunny-alpha` 的历史免费条件不能套用到官方 API。

sections.title: 如何使用与复测 MiniMax M3.1 Flash
sections.body:
[打开正式版模型页](/zh-CN/model/minimax-m3-1-flash)可以进入本站试用。下方复测按钮载入第一道任务，再点击开始发送；共享试用使用默认档。若复现 low 档，请配置自己的 MiniMax Key，在额外 JSON 参数中填写：

```json
{"reasoning_effort":"low","reasoning_split":true}
```

模型 ID 使用 `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash`，不要继续发送旧匿名 ID。M3.1 Flash 必须思考，low 不等于关闭思考；`max_tokens` 还包含思考部分，过小可能截断正文。参数依据 [MiniMax OpenAI API 文档](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-openai-api)。

sections.title: 常见问题：Space Bunny 与正式版
sections.body:
**Space Bunny 就是 MiniMax M3.1 Flash 吗？** 官方确认它是早期版本；名字和产品沿革可以关联，权重及线上行为不能直接画等号。

**旧 Space Bunny 还能免费调用吗？** 本次对旧 ID 的请求得到 404。OpenRouter 的正式版 free 条目是另一个 ID，需另查当时可用性。

**正式版是否比 Preview 更强？** 本轮基础题都通过，新增边界题暴露了 low 档金额错误；没有受控的旧版同日重跑，无法给出全面升级幅度。

**能用这份结果做生产选型吗？** 可以先参考具体失败与原始回答，再用自己的工作负载、多次重复和实际部署线路复测。对金额、权限和状态转换增加确定性校验。

en.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash Review: Space Bunny, Pricing and 46 Tests
en.summary: Space Bunny was an early MiniMax M3.1 Flash. Our 46 official-API attempts expose a low-effort money error, with default 20/20 and low 19/20 text results, latency and code checks.

sections.title: Results: 20/20 text tasks at default, 19/20 at low
sections.body:
TOKRACE tested the released `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` through the official MiniMax API on October 20, 2026: **40 text attempts and 6 coding attempts**. Default effort (documented as max when omitted) passed 20/20 text tasks; low passed 19/20. Both modes passed all three coding tasks.

Median time to first answer content across 20 text tasks was **1.405 s at default and 1.089 s at low**. These are one-window, single-attempt observations from a local client. A money calculation failed at low despite valid JSON; use deterministic validation for such workflows.

sections.title: What was Space Bunny? The MiniMax identity timeline
sections.body:
[MiniMax’s October 19 announcement](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-m31f) identifies Space Bunny as an **early version** of M3.1 Flash. This establishes product lineage, not identical checkpoints or interchangeable scores.

| Date | Identity and evidence |
| --- | --- |
| September 27 | TOKRACE tested `stealth/space-bunny-alpha` via OpenRouter, 15 text attempts at low effort |
| October 3 | Official `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview`: 15 text and 3 coding attempts |
| October 19 | M3.1 Flash released; Space Bunny identity disclosed |
| October 20 | This review: 46 new official-model attempts; old Space Bunny ID probe returned HTTP 404 |

[Original Space Bunny report](/en/reports/launch-4a7f23b8cde24507-b682c375567c559a-r2) · [Original Preview review](/en/guides/minimax-m3-1-flash-preview). Historical results remain unchanged. The old anonymous endpoint returned `No endpoints found for stealth/space-bunny-alpha.` and has been retired from this site’s trial pool. That is an availability result, not a capability failure. The separate Preview ID still returned 200 in a same-day probe; this does not prove it is the released checkpoint.

sections.title: Official specifications and pricing
sections.body:
| Item | Official information checked October 20 |
| --- | --- |
| Developer / model ID | MiniMax / MiniMax-M3.1-Flash |
| Release | October 19, 2026 |
| Context | 1,000,000 tokens |
| Inputs | Text, images and video; this review tests text and code only |
| Reasoning | Mandatory; low, medium, high, xhigh, max; default max |
| API price per million tokens | $0.15 input, $0.015 cache read, $0.60 output |
| Weights | Announcement says later; downloadable weights not verified here |

Sources: [release](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-m31f) and [model guide](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/text-generation). MiniMax reports 73.7% on DeepSWE v1.1 and 61.7% on OSWorld V2. These are **vendor-reported benchmarks**, not TOKRACE results. We did not reproduce those benchmarks or test vision, desktop operation or million-token context.

sections.title: Method and limits
sections.body:
We fixed 15 existing text tasks, five new edge cases and three JavaScript tasks before calling either mode. Each task ran once per mode, with alternating pair order. **No failed-attempt retries or best-of selection** were used. Edge cases cover shipping and discounts, an instruction embedded in source data, final event states, superseded evidence and nullable types.

Requests used `https://api.minimax.io/v1/chat/completions`, temperature 0, streaming, `reasoning_split=true`, a 2,048-token text limit and an 8,192-token coding limit; timeout 120 seconds. Default omitted `reasoning_effort`; low explicitly sent `low`. Text was checked against fixed answers/JSON, code against predetermined assertions in an isolated VM. All 26 coding checks per mode completed; the reported score unit is tasks.

First content measures request start to the first nonempty answer fragment; first reasoning is recorded separately. API completion tokens include reasoning. Calls originated on local macOS; egress and provider region were not verified. Cache, load and routing were uncontrolled. One attempt per task cannot establish reliability, an overall ranking or broad reasoning quality.

Small-function checks do not establish repository repair, tool-use or end-to-end agent success rates.

sections.title: Retained failure: low missed the shipping charge
sections.body:
The prompt specified 19.90 × 3, plus 4.50 shipping, minus a 5.00 order discount. The correct total is **59.20**, requiring `{"totalCents":5920}`. Low returned `{"totalCents":5470}`, 450 cents short and equal to merchandise minus discount. Default returned 5920.

Valid JSON did not make the answer correct. We neither inspect nor publish private reasoning; the missing-shipping description concerns the numeric output, not its internal cause. [Inspect the original prompt and answer](#evidence-edge-money-total-low).

sections.body:
| Test | Text passed | Median first content | Route / effort |

| M3.1 Flash Preview, October 3 | 15/15 | 1.127 s | Local → MiniMax, default |
| Released model, October 20, original 15 tasks | 15/15 | 1.373 s | Local → MiniMax, default |
| Released model, October 20, original 15 tasks | 15/15 | 1.056 s | Local → MiniMax, low |

Only the original 15 tasks enter this historical table. The five new cases are excluded. Dates, routes, settings and upstream versions differ: **this is not a controlled before/after experiment**, and supports no release-versus-Space-Bunny speedup or regression claim. Download the [Space Bunny report](/api/reports/launch-4a7f23b8cde24507-b682c375567c559a-r2) and [Preview evidence](/evaluations/minimax-m3-1-flash-preview.json).

sections.title: List price, free routing and actual spending
sections.body:
The 46 formal evaluation requests have a **list-price equivalent of approximately $0.004424**, using reported cached tokens and token usage. Subscription credentials were used. This is not an invoice or measured incremental cash spend, and excludes connectivity probes and browser retests.

On October 20, [OpenRouter’s released-model listing](https://openrouter.ai/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free) included `minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free`. It is a different route with changeable availability; the 46 tests did not use it. TOKRACE’s released-model trial uses the official MiniMax API and site quotas. Historical free pricing for the old anonymous ID does not apply to the official API.

sections.title: Use the released model and reproduce a task
sections.body:
The [released model page](/en/model/minimax-m3-1-flash) links to a trial. The rerun button below loads the first task; press Start to send it. Shared trials use default effort. To reproduce low effort, configure your own MiniMax key and these extra JSON parameters:

```json
{"reasoning_effort":"low","reasoning_split":true}
```

Use model ID `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash`, not the retired anonymous ID. Reasoning is mandatory: low is not disabled reasoning. The output-token budget includes reasoning, so a small limit can truncate the answer. See the [official OpenAI-compatible API reference](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-openai-api).

sections.title: Space Bunny and M3.1 Flash FAQ
sections.body:
**Is Space Bunny MiniMax M3.1 Flash?** MiniMax identifies it as an early version. Product lineage does not prove identical weights or serving behavior.

**Can I still call the old Space Bunny free endpoint?** Our old-ID request returned 404. OpenRouter’s released-model free listing uses a different ID and requires a fresh availability check.

**Is the release better than Preview?** Both passed their original basic tasks. The new edge cases exposed a low-effort money error. There was no matched same-day old-version retest, so no broad improvement percentage is justified.

**Can this guide production selection?** Use the concrete failure and original answers to design your own workload tests, repeated across your deployment route. Validate money, permissions and state transitions deterministically.
